Use case: ui-mockup
ONE Lighthouse LH01-0081 展開できる詳細条件の見出し行. Input1 original controls collapsed-row chevron geometry and divider position; input2 native mock supplies Japanese label/Regular type scale.
Purewhite#FFFFFF single compact full-width row. Left text exactly "施設の種類", Meiryo REGULAR40014/24-equivalent tracking0, dark#1D1D1D. NOT a bold section heading. At far right, original simple downward V chevron, thin two equal angled strokes, slate#526173; keep source angle/optical size, no triangle fill, arrow shaft, circle or plus. Label and chevron vertically centered.
Preserve original fine neutral horizontal divider ABOVE the row; mock places it below but original assigned crop is authority. Original comfortably spaced left/right alignment and compact row padding. No bottom divider added, enclosing card/border, secondary text, expanded options, icon before label, colored fill/green accent or shadow. Small white outside margins, crisp flat frontal wide raster. Collapsed state only; expand/collapse, focus and keyboard behavior unverified.
reviewNotes: Japanese Regular label, white collapsed row and original upper divider retained. Downward chevron rendered too large/heavy relative to source/native body scale; needs narrow glyph optical-size/stroke correction. Raster candidate only.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
